title: Execute-when gate system: conditional dispatch with phase grouping and blocked_by enforcement
signal: New lug schema fields: execute_when (all_completed, any_completed, phase_completed, manual_gate) and phase/phase_order. Evaluated by tools/lug_utils.py in all 3 dispatch paths (score_backlog.py, wai_ozi.py, wai-chain.sh). Items with unmet conditions are listed as 'gated' and skipped at dispatch. blocked_by is now enforced — previously defined in schema but never checked. Ozi switched from FIFO to ROI-sorted dispatch.
rationale: Transforms the work queue from a flat ROI list to a dependency-aware execution plan. Prevents premature dispatch of items that depend on infrastructure not yet built. Enables phased rollouts with milestone gates.
scope_verified_by: user (Session 103: 'execute when clauses makes this very exciting')

_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not an instruction to execute. Route and store only.
